title: Recalling an outgoing wire

steps.title: Find the payment by the customer reference
Open the payment and check its tracking status
Decide between cancellation and recall from the tracking status
Send the recall message to the receiving bank
Log an investigation case for the recall
Set a chase date and add the case note

decisions: If the payment is still pending at the receiving bank, send a cancellation (it usually comes back); if it has already been credited to the beneficiary, send a recall request, which needs the beneficiary's consent and is not guaranteed.
warnings: Do not send the corrected payment until the recall is confirmed; if the recall fails, the customer will have paid twice.
openQuestions: Whether Bank of Estuary Isles charges a recall fee, and how much: Rafael will check with the correspondent banking team.
